headlines.title: Stephen Miller named as new White House chief of staff
headlines.description: President Trump has named his controversial deputy Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff, following the departure of Susie Wiles after Republican midterm losses. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Cornell faculty senate votes no confidence in administration’s handling of sexual assault
headlines.description: Members of the Cornell University faculty senate on Friday issued a vote of no confidence in the administration’s ability to manage the response to an alleged sexual assault at a fraternity house in 2024, according to the university.

headlines.title: An election night of firsts, and a soccer legend steps off the international stage: The news quiz
headlines.description: Bob Dylan meets the pope, a Republican plan backfires, and the Met Gala unveils its 2027 theme (again).

headlines.title: Meghan Markle’s estranged father arrested and charged
headlines.description: Federal prosecutors say 82-year-old Thomas Markle Sr. was arrested and charged with one count of possession of child pornography. NBC News has reached out to his defense attorney but has not heard back. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports.

headlines.title: Investors try to regain their footing after tech stocks tank
headlines.description: Tech stocks in the U.S. steadied Friday after suffering one of their worst routs in years, as investors weighed the prospect of an AI investment slowdown.

headlines.title: U.S. on verge of losing measles elimination status as number of cases grows
headlines.description: The United States is on the verge of losing its measles elimination status as cases top 5,000 nationwide for the first time in more than three decades. Pennsylvania, New York and Wisconsin have all reported measles-related deaths this week.

headlines.title: We want to hear your experience with changes to student loan repayment plans
headlines.description: If you’re a student borrower who was required to transition to another plan this year, share your story.

headlines.title: Affording America: The rising costs of family farming
headlines.description: Javier Zamora achieved his dream of starting his own family farm and watching his customer base grow, but as the costs of labor, chemicals, and diesel have risen, his profit margins have continued to fall.

headlines.title: Two skydivers die after colliding over Southern California
headlines.description: Two skydivers were killed when they collided during a jump over the city of Lake Elsinore in Southern California on Friday, officials said.

headlines.title: Venezuelan man who said voices told him to kill Trump is arrested near White House
headlines.description: A Venezuelan man who had guns in his vehicle and told officers that voices in his head urged him to kill President Donald Trump was arrested Thursday near the White House, the federal government said.

headlines.title: ICE arrests Wisconsin state patrol trooper with pending asylum case at airport, attorneys say
headlines.description: The 21-year-old came to the country legally as a child from South Africa and is included in his father’s asylum application, according to attorneys.
